resources.name: free-for-dev (free tiers catalog)
best_for: finding $0 alternatives before proposing any paid service
resources.notes: Crowd-edited list, ~1.7k lines, 60+ categories. Limits change often, so verify the provider's pricing page before adopting anything. Each provider adopted from it gets its own resource entry (trust NEW). Sections most used by UIBuilder: Web Hosting, CDN and Protection, Forms, Email, Monitoring, Analytics, Crash and Exception Handling, Font, Design and UI, DNS, Screenshot APIs.
